```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

bp <- 15
set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
hearing_trials_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "hearing_trials_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
hearing_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "hearing_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
# Restrict to the Study 1 analytic sample
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

hearing_participants <- hearing_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

hearing_trials_analytic <- hearing_trials_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")
```

```{r}
## Hearing-test availability and participant-level descriptives

hearing_availability <- dem_analytic %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender,
    age
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    hearing_participants %>%
      dplyr::select(
        id,
        participant.code,
        mean_threshold
      ) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(hearing_test_available = TRUE),
    by = c("id", "participant.code")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hearing_test_available =
      replace_na(hearing_test_available, FALSE)
  )

# Hearing-test availability: overall
hearing_availability %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_hearing_test_available =
      sum(hearing_test_available),
    prop_hearing_test_available =
      mean(hearing_test_available),
    percent_hearing_test_available =
      100 * mean(hearing_test_available)
  )

# Hearing-test availability: by gender
hearing_availability %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_hearing_test_available =
      sum(hearing_test_available),
    prop_hearing_test_available =
      mean(hearing_test_available),
    percent_hearing_test_available =
      100 * mean(hearing_test_available),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Participants with at least one observed hearing threshold
hearing_descriptive_sample <- hearing_availability %>%
  filter(
    hearing_test_available,
    !is.na(mean_threshold))

# Hearing descriptives: overall
hearing_descriptive_sample %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),

    mean_auditory_discomfort_threshold =
      mean(mean_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_threshold =
      sd(mean_threshold, na.rm = TRUE))

# Hearing descriptives: by gender
hearing_descriptive_sample %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),

    mean_auditory_discomfort_threshold =
      mean(mean_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_threshold =
      sd(mean_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
# Participant IDs for everyone who completed the hearing test
valid_hearing_participants <- hearing_availability %>%
  filter(hearing_test_available) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    participant.code
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Trial-level data for the full hearing-test sample
hearing_trials_model <- hearing_trials_analytic %>%
  semi_join(
    valid_hearing_participants,
    by = c("id", "participant.code")
  )
```


```{r}
# Trial-level censoring
hearing_trials_model %>%
  mutate(censored = is.na(threshold)) %>%
  summarise(
    trials_total = n(),
    trials_censored = sum(censored),
    prop_censored = mean(censored)
  )

hearing_trials_model %>%
  mutate(censored = is.na(threshold)) %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    trials_total = n(),
    trials_censored = sum(censored),
    prop_censored = mean(censored),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hearing_trials_model %>%
  mutate(censored = is.na(threshold)) %>%
  group_by(gender, freq_Hz) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_censored = mean(censored),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(freq_Hz, prop_censored, colour = gender)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 1: proportion censored by frequency",
    x = "Frequency (Hz)",
    y = "Proportion censored")
```

```{r}
# Descriptive plots
hearing_trials_model %>%
  filter(!is.na(threshold)) %>%
  group_by(gender, ear, freq_Hz) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_threshold = mean(threshold),
    se = sd(threshold) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(freq_Hz, mean_threshold, colour = ear)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_threshold - se, ymax = mean_threshold + se), width = 0.05) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(200, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000)) +
  facet_grid(. ~ gender) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 1: mean threshold by frequency and gender",
    x = "Frequency (Hz)",
    y = "Mean threshold"
  )

hearing_trials_model %>%
  filter(!is.na(threshold)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold, fill = gender)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Study 1: observed threshold density")
```

```{r}
# Data preparation for JAGS models
# Gender coding used in JAGS:
# 1 = Male
# 2 = Female
participants_all <- hearing_trials_model %>%
  filter(!is.na(gender)) %>%
  distinct(id, position, gender) %>%
  unite("person_id", c(id, position), remove = FALSE) %>%
  arrange(person_id) %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number())

frequencies <- hearing_trials_model %>%
  distinct(freq_Hz) %>%
  arrange(freq_Hz) %>%
  mutate(freq_ID = row_number())

n_freq <- nrow(frequencies)

Y_all <- hearing_trials_model %>%
  filter(!is.na(gender)) %>%
  unite("person_id", c(id, position), remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(participants_all %>% dplyr::select(person_id, ID), by = "person_id") %>%
  left_join(frequencies, by = "freq_Hz") %>%
  mutate(
    gender = ifelse(gender == "Male", 1L, 2L),
    ear = ifelse(ear == "LEFT", 1L, 2L)
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.integer(ID),
    gender = as.integer(gender),
    freq_ID = as.integer(freq_ID),
    ear = as.integer(ear),
    threshold = as.numeric(threshold)
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID, freq_ID, ear)

p_info <- participants_all %>%
  transmute(
    ID = as.integer(ID),
    gender = as.integer(ifelse(gender == "Male", 1L, 2L))
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID)

# Missing trial thresholds indicate no response within the tested range and are treated as censored at the upper boundary BP = 15
cens <- as.numeric(is.na(Y_all$threshold))
Y_mat <- as.matrix(Y_all)
storage.mode(Y_mat) <- "double"
p_info_mat <- as.matrix(p_info)
storage.mode(p_info_mat) <- "double"
storage.mode(cens) <- "double"

data_list_all <- list(
  Y = Y_mat,
  cens = cens,
  BP = bp,
  p_info = p_info_mat,
  n_freq = n_freq
)
```

```{r}
# Overall hearing model
params <- c(
  "mu", "delta", "a", "sigma", "mu_gender", "mu_i",
  "mu_prior", "delta_prior", "sigma_prior", "a_prior", "mu_gender_prior"
)

samples_path <- file.path(results_path, "s1_jags_hearing_ttest_overall.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path)) {
  samples_all <- readRDS(samples_path)
} else {
  samples_all <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_all,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params,
    model.file = file.path(models_path, "t-test_Hearing.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_all, samples_path)
}

samples_all
```

```{r}
# Bayes factor for overall gender effect
s_all <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_all))
delta_draws_all <- s_all[, "delta"]

d_post <- density(delta_draws_all)
post_at_0 <- approx(d_post$x, d_post$y, xout = 0)$y
prior_at_0 <- dt(0, df = 1)

bf01_all <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0
bf01_all

plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = s_all,
  posterior_name = "delta",
  prior_name = "delta_prior",
  xlab = "Standardised female − male auditory discomfort threshold difference",
  vline = 0,
  title = "Study 1 prior vs posterior: overall auditory discomfort threshold gender effect",
  central_prob = 0.95
)
```

```{r}
# Posterior group means
mu_m_all <- s_all[, "mu_gender[1]"]
mu_w_all <- s_all[, "mu_gender[2]"]

tibble(Male = mu_m_all, Female = mu_w_all) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = "mu") %>%
  ggplot(aes(mu, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Study 1 posterior group means")
```

```{r}
# By-frequency model
samples_path_indf <- file.path(results_path, "s1_jags_hearing_ttest_by_freq.rds")

if (file.exists(samples_path_indf)) {
  samples_all_indf <- readRDS(samples_path_indf)
} else {
  samples_all_indf <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_all,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = c(
      "mu", "delta", "a", "sigma",
      "mu_prior", "delta_prior", "sigma_prior", "a_prior", "mu_gender_prior"
    ),
    model.file = file.path(models_path, "t-test_Hearing_by_frequency.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_all_indf, samples_path_indf)
}

samples_all_indf

s_indf <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_all_indf))
delta_cols <- grep("^delta\\[", colnames(s_indf), value = TRUE)

posterior_delta <- as_tibble(s_indf) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(delta_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(freq_ID = as.integer(str_extract(name, "\\d+"))) %>%
  left_join(
    frequencies,
    by = "freq_ID")

posterior_delta %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, colour = factor(freq_Hz))) +
  geom_density() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Study 1 frequency-specific gender differences in auditory discomfort threshold",
       x = "female-male auditory discomfort threshold difference",
       colour = "Frequency (Hz)")
```

```{r}
for (col in delta_cols) {
  draws <- s_indf[, col]
  d_post <- density(draws)
  post_at_0 <- approx(d_post$x, d_post$y, xout = 0)$y
  prior_at_0 <- dt(0, df = 1)
  bf01 <- post_at_0 / prior_at_0

  freq_id <- as.integer(str_extract(col, "\\d+"))
  freq_hz <- frequencies$freq_Hz[frequencies$freq_ID == freq_id]

  cat(paste0(freq_hz, " Hz: BF01 ~ ", round(bf01, 2), "\n"))
}

freq_labels <- frequencies %>%
  arrange(freq_ID) %>%
  pull(freq_Hz)


hearing_prior_post_freq <- map_dfr(seq_along(freq_labels), function(i) {
  tibble(
    value = c(
      s_indf[, paste0("delta[", i, "]")],
      s_indf[, paste0("delta_prior[", i, "]")]),
    distribution = rep(
      c("posterior", "prior"),
      each = nrow(s_indf)),
    freq_Hz = factor(
      freq_labels[i],
      levels = freq_labels))})

p_hearing_prior_post_freq <-
  ggplot(
    hearing_prior_post_freq %>%
      filter(value >= -6, value <= 6),
    aes(
      x = value,
      colour = distribution,
      fill = distribution)) +
  geom_density(
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 3) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ freq_Hz,
    ncol = 3,
    labeller = labeller(
      freq_Hz = function(x) paste0(x, " Hz"))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Study 1 prior vs posterior: auditory discomfort threshold gender effect by frequency",
    x = "Standardised female − male auditory discomfort threshold difference",
    y = "Density",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_hearing_prior_post_freq
```


## Auditory discomfort threshold and button-press behaviour
```{r}
# Participant-specific latent hearing threshold parameters
mu_i_cols <- grep(
  "^mu_i\\[",
  colnames(s_all),
  value = TRUE)

hearing_latent_scores <- tibble(
  parameter = mu_i_cols,
  ID = parse_number(mu_i_cols),
  latent_discomfort_threshold = map_dbl(
    mu_i_cols,
    ~ mean(s_all[, .x])))

print(hearing_latent_scores, n =85)
```

```{r}
hearing_person_lookup <- hearing_trials_model %>%
  distinct(
    id,
    participant.code,
    position,
    gender) %>%
  unite(
    "person_id",
    c(id, position),
    remove = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(
    participants_all %>%
      dplyr::select(person_id, ID),
    by = "person_id") %>%
  distinct(
    ID,
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender)
```

```{r}
hearing_buttonpress_people <- hearing_person_lookup %>%
```


```{r}
# Posterior probabilities
mcmc_hearing <- as.mcmc(samples_hearing_buttonpress)
hearing_buttonpress_draws <- as.matrix(mcmc_hearing)

pp_hearing_own <-
  mean(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own"] < 0)

pp_hearing_partner <-
  mean(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner"] < 0)

pp_hearing_relative <-
  mean(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative"] < 0)

c(own = pp_hearing_own,
  partner = pp_hearing_partner,
  relative = pp_hearing_relative)

# Bayes factors for point-null effects at zero

# Own auditory discomfort-threshold effect
d_post_hearing_own <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own"])

d_prior_hearing_own <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own_prior"])

post_at_0_hearing_own <- approx(
  d_post_hearing_own$x,
  d_post_hearing_own$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_hearing_own <- approx(
  d_prior_hearing_own$x,
  d_prior_hearing_own$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_hearing_own <-
  post_at_0_hearing_own /
  prior_at_0_hearing_own


# Partner auditory discomfort-threshold effect
d_post_hearing_partner <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner"])

d_prior_hearing_partner <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner_prior"])

post_at_0_hearing_partner <- approx(
  d_post_hearing_partner$x,
  d_post_hearing_partner$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_hearing_partner <- approx(
  d_prior_hearing_partner$x,
  d_prior_hearing_partner$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_hearing_partner <-
  post_at_0_hearing_partner /
  prior_at_0_hearing_partner


# Relative within-dyad auditory discomfort-threshold effect
d_post_hearing_relative <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative"])

d_prior_hearing_relative <-
  density(hearing_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative_prior"])

post_at_0_hearing_relative <- approx(
  d_post_hearing_relative$x,
  d_post_hearing_relative$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_hearing_relative <- approx(
  d_prior_hearing_relative$x,
  d_prior_hearing_relative$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_hearing_relative <-
  post_at_0_hearing_relative /
  prior_at_0_hearing_relative


c(own = bf01_hearing_own,
  partner = bf01_hearing_partner,
  relative = bf01_hearing_relative)
```


## model diagnostics
```{r}
# Traceplots
plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_auditory_discomfort_buttonpress_traceplots.png")

if (!file.exists(plot_png_path)) {

  mcmc_list_hearing_bp <-
    as.mcmc(samples_hearing_buttonpress)

  trace_df_hearing_bp <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mcmc_list_hearing_bp,
    seq_along(mcmc_list_hearing_bp),
    ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
      rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
      mutate(
        iteration = as.integer(iteration),
        chain = paste0("chain_", .y))) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      iteration,
      chain,
      alpha_male,
      alpha_female,
      beta_own,
      beta_partner,
      beta_relative,
      sigma_press,
      sigma_gender) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(iteration, chain),
      names_to = "parameter",
      values_to = "value")

  p_trace_hearing_bp <- ggplot(
    trace_df_hearing_bp,
    aes(
      x = iteration,
      y = value,
      colour = chain)) +
    geom_line(
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ parameter,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Traceplots: auditory discomfort threshold and button-press model",
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Value",
      colour = "Chain")

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_trace_hearing_bp,
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300)

} else {

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path)}
```

```{r}
  posterior_name = "beta_relative",
  prior_name = "beta_relative_prior",
  xlab = "Relative within-dyad auditory discomfort threshold effect",
  vline = 0,
  central_prob = 0.99)

p_hearing_buttonpress_prior_post <-
  plot_hearing_own /
  plot_hearing_partner /
  plot_hearing_relative

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_auditory_discomfort_buttonpress_prior_posterior.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_hearing_buttonpress_prior_post,
  width = 9,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300)
```
